Symbols:
  m_{H}: mass of H‑related component (e.g., gene product) per cell (computed)

  S_{H}: heavy-chain gene specific transcription rate [mRNA/gene·h] (parameter)
  K: heavy- and light-chain mRNA decay rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  m_{L}: light-chain mRNA amount per cell (computed)
  N_{L}: light-chain gene copy number [gene/cell] (parameter)
  S_{L}: light-chain gene specific transcription rate [mRNA/gene·h] (parameter)
  [H]: concentration of heavy‑chain monomer [chain/cell·h] (computed)
  T_{H}: heavy‑chain specific translation rate [chain/mRNA·h] (parameter)
  R_{H}: rate of heavy‑chain consumption in assembly [chain/cell·h] (computed)
  [L]: concentration of light‑chain monomer [chain/cell·h] (computed)
  T_{L}: light‑chain specific translation rate [chain/mRNA·h] (parameter)
  R_{L}: rate of light‑chain consumption in assembly [chain/cell·h] (computed)
  K_{A}: assembly rate constant for the formation of H from monomers [cell/molecule-L] (parameter)
  [H_2]: concentration of the dimeric intermediate H₂ (computed)
  [H_2L]: concentration of the complex formed by H₂ and ligand L (parameter)
  [|H_2L]: concentration of the intermediate complex |H₂L produced in reaction (24) (computed)
